semiconductor_relevance: High — LNEYA specializes in temperature control devices crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: LNEYA Thermo Refrigeration Co., Ltd. designs and produces advanced temperature control devices, specifically chillers, that are essential for maintaining precise thermal conditions in semiconductor fabrication. Their products offer a wide temperature control range and high accuracy, making them suitable for critical applications in semiconductor processes.
